mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market weakness, typically preceding economic contraction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 225 and FEDFUNDS below 0.2% indicates real rate compression, typically causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
